repair: Revise Finding f1 to state that missing-response proportions at or above the prespecified 5% problem threshold occurred in all five EQ-5D-Y-3L dimensions among children and in no dimensions among adolescents. State that this threshold occurred in three EQ-5D-Y-5L dimensions in each age group. Do not state that adolescents had no missing responses, because Table 2 reports missing responses below 5%. Add WITHIN_PERSON to the comparison structure because the same participants completed both EQ-5D-Y versions and paired responses were analysed. Add BETWEEN_GROUP because the study compared healthy and sick participants and compared age groups. Add a separate StudyFactor for continuous age in years with role EXPOSURE_OR_DETERMINANT; keep the existing age-group factor as STRATIFIER. Change Outcome o3 from PREFERENCE_OR_UTILITY to MEASUREMENT_PROPERTY because its reported outcome is empirical validity and relative efficiency of instrument scores, not participant preferences or utility levels as health outcomes.
